items.title: Two run submits can take the same lock (check-then-insert is not atomic)
items.summary: What is wrong run.( Engine).Submit checks ActiveRunForLock and then calls CreateRun as two separate statements. The index on runs.lock key is not unique, so two submits that land between those calls both succeed. That can happen with two UI requests, or the CLI in one terminal and the UI in another. Two runs then hold one lock, which is exactly what ADR-0004 exists to prevent. What we want Make the check and the…

items.title: Ctrl-C orphans running scripts: install a signal handler and honour context cancellation
items.summary: What is wrong labctl never installs a signal handler, so cmd.Context() is context.Background() and Ctrl-C kills the process with Go's default action. Scripts started through internal/toolchain run in their own process group ( Setpgid ), so the terminal's SIGINT does not reach them. They keep running with no parent, and their run stays running until the next engine start reconciles it. That breaks the promise in…

items.title: Reap the host probe child process
items.summary: prepareHost spawns the host probe and discards the child handle ( tools/zzzbench/discovery/setup.zig:189 ). items.title: Write the upload cache atomically

Suggested fix: write to a temporary file in the same directory, then rename it over pushed.json . Done when: the write goes through a temporary file and rename.

items.title: Avoid low-bitrate quality warnings for lossless audio
items.summary: Problem yaatv currently emits its low-bitrate source warning whenever the detected bitrate is below the configured threshold. That warning is useful for lossy sources such as MP3 or AAC, but it can be misleading for lossless formats such as FLAC, ALAC, WAV, or AIFF. A lossless source can have a comparatively low bitrate because of its content or compression efficiency without representing degraded source quality…
